info.title: Valo Pay sandbox API
info.description: Valo Pay collections and connected banking sandbox API. All monetary fields are integer minor units (NGN kobo). Real data and all outbound provider instructions are disabled in connected modules.

parameters.name: x-paystack-signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA512 of the exact request bytes under the configured test secret key, in hexadecimal.

400.description: The body is not JSON bytes, the connection ID is malformed, or the signed event is inconsistent or from live mode

401.description: The signature does not match the exact bytes under the configured test key; nothing was locked, read or saved

403.description: The mapped lender is not a synthetic lender in sandbox or observation mode with its kill switch on, or the mapping names another workspace

404.description: No lender is mapped to this connection ID

413.description: The body is larger than 256 KiB

429.description: More than 120 deliveries a minute from this client address; retry after the Retry-After seconds

503.description: The ingress is off or misconfigured, or the lender is busy; Paystack delivers again

post.summary: Receive a signed Paystack test event
post.description: The address to register as the webhook URL of a Paystack test account. Off unless the host sets VALOPAY_PAYSTACK_INGRESS to test. The signature is checked on the raw bytes before any lender is locked or read, so a forged or tampered delivery gets 401 and nothing else. A verified event is saved as test-mode evidence only: it creates no payment, allocation, debit or mandate authority, and still needs independent verification. Not a console call: no sandbox, sign-in or Idempotency-Key, and at most 120 deliveries a minute per client address.

parameters.description: The record's id.

parameters.name: merchantId
parameters.description: The lender (a merchant in the API) the request is scoped to; one of the caller's workspace merchants.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: One key per unchanged intention. The same key with different input is refused; a key whose request was refused cannot run again; a key whose outcome was lost recovers the original result.

post.description: Administrators only. Deletes in bounded batches with a receipt per item; blocked and failed items are reported, never skipped silently.

HealthStatus.description: The liveness answer: the build, when the process started, its uptime and what the close scheduler is doing.

SchedulerRun.description: The last scheduler pass that found work: its id, when it ran, how long it took, how many batches it read and what it did, including idle sandboxes whose automatic close it paused.

SchedulerStatus.description: Whether closes are scheduled in this process, how often it looks, when it last looked and its last pass with work.

DatabaseCheck.description: One round trip to the database and how long it took.

ReadinessStatus.description: The readiness answer: ok, or degraded while the database does not answer.

RecordData.description: A record's data: the fields the kind's schema declares, and anything else a caller stored.

ValopayRecord.description: A stored record of any kind, with its lender, status, reference, amount in kobo and data.

RecordInput.description: A new record: only the name is required; the kind's default status applies when none is given.

RecordUpdate.description: The fields to change on a record; omitted fields keep their values.

Merchant.description: A lender: its mode (observation or instruction), provider, volume, kill switch and readiness flags.

accessMode.description: Whether the server authorises a demo persona or a provisioned staff membership.

viewerScope.description: Opaque workspace/user scope for browser preferences; never an authorisation credential.

Workspace.description: The caller's workspace: who is acting, in which role, whether they signed in, and the lenders and roles available.

Metric.description: A named measurement with its unit and the basis it was derived from.

Alert.description: An NFR-OBS-02 alert: what condition holds, how severe it is, since when and the record it points at.

Overview.description: The overview: metrics, queues, recent activity, upcoming due items, the close schedule and the alerts.

RecordList.description: One page of records with the filtered total; nextOffset is present while more rows remain.

ActionInput.description: An action to run: its name, the record it applies to, the reason for it and any data it needs.

ActionResult.description: What an action did, in words, with the record it produced or changed and any data it returns.

amountUnit.description: Unit used by source amount values; defaults to kobo for existing API clients. The console requires an explicit choice.

ImportInput.description: A synthetic CSV to preview or commit for one kind, with an optional column mapping.

ImportRow.description: The outcome of one imported row.

ImportResult.description: How many rows were valid, invalid and imported, and each row's outcome.

Report.description: The reports: metrics, billing, the experiment, operational measurement and the daily closes.

Gate.description: One readiness gate: what it needs, its status and the evidence recorded.

Gates.description: The prerequisites and decisions, the sandbox's limitations, and the cash and burn figures used for the funding decision.

Timeline.description: A customer, their derived position, and every related event, mandate, due item and payment.

Settings.description: A lender's settings and the caller's permissions, with integrations, members and the business calendar.

SettingsInput.description: The execution settings to change; every field is optional.

ExportInput.description: What to export (a record kind, gate-pack, billing, dispute-pack or customer-pack with a customerId) and in which format.

ExportResult.description: Saved export job identity, status and retry details. Checksum, generatedAt and file size appear only when ready; the download route rejects unfinished jobs. Optional status retains compatibility with older immediate-export responses.

EffectiveCloseSchedule.description: Lender schedule combined with the actual scheduler service status. nextAt is present only when automatic closes are available; run history belongs only to this lender. failedAttempts and retryAt describe failed automatic attempts at the pending time (retryAt only while automatic closes are available); pausedForInactivityAt says when the scheduler switched off the automatic close of a sandbox nobody changed. Answers from earlier builds may lack these three fields.

QueuePage.description: A bounded priority queue page with complete filter counts, available owners and types, the applied offset and lender-scoped linked records. Counts are calculated before pagination. asOf is the timestamp used to determine overdue and due-today states.

ReconciliationPage.description: A database-filtered reconciliation queue page, with complete count and lender-scoped linked evidence. Precision metadata describes the complete seeded monthly sample.

CloseHistoryPage.description: Paged close summaries and first/latest closing positions for the entire WAT date range; full REC-07 evidence is fetched separately.

CustomerHistoryCounts.description: Complete counts or actual offsets for the four customer-history sections.

CustomerHistory.description: Bounded pages of customer records with balances derived from every related record, full section counts and an optional lender-scoped selected record.

ConnectedWorkspace.description: Synthetic connected workspace. Credit and Cash views carry evidence, permissions and refusal states. Every gate has liveEnabled false. No read creates sample records.

ConnectedActionInput.description: Action-specific data is validated by the server. Names use consent, payment, credit or cash prefixes. Every action requires a current whole-workspace revision and a reason. No input can enable live routes.

ConnectedActionResult.description: Committed sample operation. Cash actions include their record and outcome inside record; use the refreshed workspace view for display. A receipt is evidence from the server simulator only.

Message.description: A confirmation in plain words; nothing else changed that the caller needs to read back.

OperationView.description: One journal entry: what was asked, by whom, in which role, and whether the service confirmed it. Original request bodies stay private; a completed entry names the record it produced. A refused entry is cancelled and its message says why.

OperationList.description: The caller's journal for one lender, newest first, 25 rows a page.

OperationReplayResult.description: The original route's answer, recovered or re-run under the current validation and authorisation; its shape is that route's response.

JourneyCounts.description: Record counts that place the lender on the pilot journey: customers, committed batches, receipts, open and unassigned cases, closes and ready exports.

PilotJourney.description: The lender, the caller's access mode and the counts behind the journey view. Synthetic throughout.

ImportBatchList.description: Import batches newest first, 25 a page, with their source identity, quality totals and check counts but not their rows.

ImportBatchDetail.description: One batch with its source rows (import operator roles only) and every saved revision.

BatchVersion.description: The batch version being committed; a stale version is refused (409).

ImportBatchInput.description: A synthetic source batch: source, source batch ID, record kind, mapping, identity column, amount unit and up to 500 CSV rows. syntheticOnly must be true; raw bank details are refused.

Assignee.description: A person who can own a case or review a close: demo roles in the sandbox, active staff with lender access on a staff host.

EvidenceLink.description: A record the case can cite as evidence.

CaseDetail.description: One exception with the people it can be handed to, its handover events and the records it can cite.

CaseInput.description: A case handover or update: assignee, next action and its time, note and evidence, with the version being changed.

PilotLenderInput.description: A new synthetic lender for a staff workspace: name and segment.

StaffMember.description: A staff membership: its role, state and expiry, and (in the directory) the lenders it may open; an administrator sees every lender.

StaffInvitation.description: A pending, accepted or revoked invitation; the token is shown once, at creation.

StaffEvent.description: One entry of the team's access history.

StaffDirectory.description: The team as the caller may see it: members and lenders for everyone, invitations and history for administrators. In the sandbox the lists are empty and the message says why.

InvitationInput.description: An invitation: email address and pilot role.

InvitationCreated.description: The invitation and its one-time acceptance token; no email is sent.

AcceptInvitationInput.description: The acceptance token from the invitation link.

InvitationAccepted.description: Confirmation of the new membership and its role.

MembershipInput.description: A membership change: role, state, the version being changed and the reason.

StaffLenderAccessInput.description: The lenders a non-administrator membership may open, with the version being changed and the reason.

StaffLenderAccess.description: The membership with its saved lender access.

ReadinessCheck.description: One readiness control (identity, MFA, origins, database isolation, encryption) with its state on this host and what it means.

AccessReadiness.description: The staff-access and encryption controls as this request observed them. Describes configuration; never reveals secrets.

EncryptionVerification.description: The result of sealing and opening a synthetic payload with the configured managed key.

PayloadProtection.description: How many stored payloads one bounded run protected, and whether another run is needed.

ProgressStep.description: One pilot step with its state, the evidence behind that state and what is still missing.

PilotAccess.description: Whether real staff access is enabled on this host and what demo progress does not establish.

PilotProgress.description: The lender's progress through onboarding, ingestion, reconciliation, exceptions, close review and export, derived from its records.

CloseReviewRecord.description: A close review record with whether its snapshot still matches the close and its source evidence.

CloseReviewEntry.description: One close with the discrepancies a reviewer must answer, why it cannot be reviewed now (if so), pending financial corrections and its reviews.

CloseReviewList.description: The 25 newest closes with their reviews, the Finance reviewers available and who the caller is, so the console can enforce separation of duties.

PrepareCloseReviewInput.description: A close review preparation: the close and its version, an independent Finance reviewer, the preparation note and a response to every discrepancy.

DecideCloseReviewInput.description: A review decision: approve or reject with the version being decided, a note and an answer to every source exception.

ImportCorrectionPreviewInput.description: The batch, the imported record with its version, and the supported field changes to compare.

ImportCorrectionPreview.description: The before/after comparison, the records the change touches, any blockers and the digest a proposal must quote.

ImportCorrectionProposalInput.description: A proposal quoting the preview digest, naming an independent Finance reviewer, with the reason and evidence.

ImportCorrectionDecisionInput.description: Approve, reject or withdraw, quoting the proposal digest, with a reason.

ImportCorrectionView.description: A proposal with its preview, its decision if any, and whether the comparison is still current.

ImportCorrectionList.description: The batch's imported records, its proposals and the Finance reviewers available.

SourceProfileInput.description: A reusable synthetic source contract: mapping, identity column, amount unit, first expected delivery, cadence, grace and expected totals.

SourceManifestInput.description: The files and control totals expected for one WAT business date, or an explicit no-file declaration, with reason and evidence; a revision names the declaration it replaces.

SourceCompleteness.description: Whether the declared source files for a business date arrived complete, with each file's state, the profiles that expect a delivery by that date, undeclared batches and the issues Finance must answer.

SourceBatchQuality.description: The original committed totals and checks of a source batch.

PaystackFixtureInput.description: A recorded Paystack test scenario to deliver to the inbox.

ProviderReplayInput.description: A replay of a stored provider event, with its version and the reason.

SourceDelivery.description: Where a profile stands against its cadence: missed deliveries, the next expected time and the last committed batch.

SourceProfile.description: A source profile record with its delivery state.

SourceBatchSummary.description: A batch as the sources page lists it, with its original quality totals.

SourceSummary.description: Counts that need attention: late sources, duplicate and conflicting rows, batches needing review.

ProviderEvent.description: A stored provider event: fixture or test mode, how often it was delivered and replayed, and the guarantee that it created no financial record.

PaystackInbox.description: The read-only Paystack test inbox: its fixed test-only state, the stored events and how many were quarantined or duplicated.

SourcesView.description: Everything the sources page shows for one lender and business date.

PaystackFixtureResult.description: Whether the fixture was accepted or recognised as a duplicate, and the stored event.

data.description: The event's payload as Paystack sent it.

PaystackTestEvent.description: A Paystack test event exactly as Paystack signed it. The signature covers these bytes, so the body is authenticated before it is parsed. charge.success and the two direct-debit authorisation events are recorded; any other signed event is acknowledged and recorded as ignored.

PaystackDeliveryReceipt.description: The acknowledgement Paystack receives: the signed event is saved in the mapped lender's inbox, or recognised as a repeat delivery of one already saved.

PersonalWorkView.description: The caller's (or, for administrators, the team's) cases, handovers, reviews and notifications, paged and counted.

WorkReceiptInput.description: The item being acknowledged, with its version.

WorkReceipt.description: The recorded acknowledgement: who, what, and when.

LifecycleView.description: The lender's retention policy, holds, bounded inventory of what the policy would touch, and saved retention runs.

LifecycleRunView.description: One retention run: its reviewed manifest, approval state and per-item receipts.

RetentionPolicyInput.description: The retention periods per kind, with the version being changed and the reason.

RetentionHoldInput.description: A hold on one item, or its release, with the reason.

LifecyclePreviewInput.description: Which kinds to preview and the reason for the run.

LifecycleApproveInput.description: Approval of a previewed run, quoting its manifest digest.

LifecycleExecuteInput.description: Execution of an approved run, quoting its manifest digest, in bounded batches.
